question: What is the amount and expiry of the StepFun Open Platform (platform.stepfun.ai) new-account free credit, and which document does its individual identity verification take?
why: No vendor page states an amount; the voucher record and account overview pages need a signed-in account (behind a sign-up). One user reported a USD 100 voucher in May 2026 and another saw none, and the Step Plan 15-day trial promotion ended on Aug 24, 2026.
